children: AI-native skills management platform's fiscal Q2 revenue fell 3% yr/yr to $98.2 mln
Adjusted EBITDA for fiscal Q2 rose to $33 mln, margin improved to 34% of revenue
Company completed sale of Global Knowledge business, focusing on core platform
Skillsoft now sees fiscal 2027 revenue at $380 mln–$390 mln, down from $388 mln–$406 mln
Company maintains fiscal 2027 adjusted EBITDA guidance at $108 mln–$116 mln
Skillsoft expects fiscal 2027 free cash flow of $14 mln–$22 mln, unchanged from prior forecast
ENTERPRISE BUSINESS - Co said enterprise segment performed as planned, supported by healthy retention and growing platform adoption
AI-ENABLED PLATFORM - Co cited encouraging progress in customer engagement, early platform adoption and pipeline expansion, with new AI features such as LX Design Studio and AI Coach
CONSUMER BUSINESS PRESSURE - Co said accelerating pressure in the consumer business contributed to revised revenue outlook
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "hold"
The average consensus recommendation for the professional & business education peer group is "buy."
